digest.component_or_area: pai_retry wire history processor (LLM context-window seam)
propositions: The request-side context-window check in wire_history_processor never fires on first requests because the filter predicate only descends into ModelResponse+_is_failed_output_response messages, and a first request history is [ModelRequest], leaving the sole raise site (_wire_keeps_response) unreachable.

An oversized first request (3.6M chars against 1M-token window) passes the seam with zero executions of _wire_keeps_response, then fails at the provider with 400 surfaced as LLMUnavailableError (provider-outage semantics) instead of ContextWindowExceededError before any provider call.

A shared request-side token estimator must use 4 chars/token calibration to keep enrich's window*2-char bound admissible (scores at ~window/2 tokens, passes); chars/2 would fail closed and break AC#3.

The fix requires adding _request_text_chars, _estimate_request_tokens, and _check_request_fit helpers to detect over-window requests in the wire projection before any provider call, raising ContextWindowExceededError (an LLMError caught by existing handlers).
